title: Dali and xuixo
text: Dali museum itself deserves the trip! It was an amazing experience. If you love surrealism or just curious, you must visit the place! Walking and exploring the streets of Girona was a nice and relaxing addition. Relax there and have some xuixo.
author: Sightseer25746509115

title: Great day in Girona and the Dali Museum.
text: Wonderful tour of Girona and the Dali Museum.  The guide was very knowledgeable and friendly, and the driver was solid also.
author: Linda K

title: Dali!!
text: Carlos, the guide, was very informative and explained everything very well. We had time to see what we liked. The recommendations in Girona were beautiful. The driver and Carlos made for one of the best days of my vacation.
author: Aniela L

title: Highly Recommend
text: Sandra and Jessica were lovely, helpful and made the excursion fun. Wasn't expecting to enjoy Girona, Dali museum was my goal. I was very pleasantly surprised. If you are a Game of Thrones fan, a must! Sorry I missed the flower festival. Loved the Dali Museum
author: hrhleg

text:
